mapper.select: SELECT fc.id, u.name AS authorName, fc.content FROM feed_comments fc JOIN users u ON u.id = fc.user_id WHERE fc.feed_post_id = #{feedId} ORDER BY fc.created_at ASC, fc.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_comments ( feed_post_id, user_id, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{feedId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT fc.id, u.name AS authorName, fc.content FROM feed_comments fc JOIN users u ON u.id = fc.user_id WHERE fc.feed_post_id = #{feedId} AND fc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fc.id DESC LIMIT 1
